# AXM Workshop v0.6.0 Experimental

This prerelease is a reviewed public-safe integration checkpoint for the AXM
Collaboration Platform. It is **experimental technical integration**, not
production certification, promotion, roots authority, or CANON.

## Included

- **AI-native game production runner** — external job/cache/tier roots, explicit
  source-write refusal, exact approvals for retention changes, and honest
  labeling of trusted in-process executors.
- **Hardware research registry and compute-substrate lab** — records remain
  `DESIGN_ONLY` / `PROPOSED`; no physical control, deployment, procurement,
  safety-certification, promotion, roots, or CANON authority.
- **Complete-warning delta** — deterministic change orientation while preserving
  all 43 known RepairBuddy warnings as open. No acknowledgement, suppression, or
  automatic repair is implied.
- **Deterministic PR publisher** — an `EXPERIMENTAL` / `HIGH`-risk adapter whose
  maximum authorized effect is one ordinary feature-branch push and one draft
  pull-request create or update after exact one-use confirmation. It cannot
  stage, commit, force-push, merge, close, delete, promote, alter roots, or
  change CANON.

## Evidence at cutoff

- Pull requests #29, #30, #32, and #33 were reviewed and merged with their exact
  head commits pinned.
- The combined integration state passed the public discovery/static gates.
- The combined integration state passed a clean Windows launch from a fresh
  path with no Node.js initially on `PATH`.
- The release workflow re-runs discovery verification and the public GitHub/site
  surface tests before publishing this prerelease.

Reviewed integration base: `ce47b43b4fa5883a8fe4b9ee7330f75a54e1693f`.

## Known boundaries

- This is not a claim that every module is production-ready or independently
  security-audited.
- Clean macOS/Linux first-launch proof and independent beginner comprehension
  remain outside this cutoff.
- The 43 RepairBuddy warnings remain open.
- No broad open-source license has been granted. Read `LICENSE_STATUS.md` before
  reuse or redistribution.
